issue.title: autocompletion not working on windows bash & powershell
issue.body:
its possible to remove the .exe extension to use binaries in windows git bash by specifying shopt -s completion_strip_exe
but bash still calls it with the exe extension. this leads to the issue that the completions are only registerd for the `binary.exe` and not also for just `binary`

e.g.: https://github.com/containers/podman/issues/16499

it registers only podman.exe: complete -o default -F __start_podman.exe podman.exe
it should also inlclude without .exe extension: complete -o default -F __start_podman.exe podman.exe podman.

comments.body: autocompletion for powerhsell also does not work as its using e.g `podman.exe` in the variable names, turning it into a property lookup
